name: CHT Taipei IDC (Banqiao)
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC page lists its flagship Taipei IDC at Banqiao District, New Taipei City; Taiwan Reporter (twreporter) cites the Banqiao data center as having a 40 MW load, the largest single CHT facility. Third-party listings (Data Center Map, DataCenterJournal) give the address as No. 8 Guoqing Rd., Banqiao District, New Taipei.

name: CHT New Taipei Tamsui IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the New Taipei Tamsui IDC among its rated-3-class and professional-class IDC facilities in the Greater Taipei area. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT New Taipei Sanchong IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the New Taipei Sanchong IDC (Sanchong District, New Taipei City) as an operational IDC site. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT New Taipei Xinzhuang IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the New Taipei Xinzhuang IDC (Xinzhuang District, New Taipei City) as an operational IDC site; the same page also lists a New Taipei Yonghe IDC, giving CHT five IDC sites in New Taipei (Banqiao, Tamsui, Sanchong, Xinzhuang, Yonghe). No capacity published.

name: Ubilink AI Supercomputing Center
developer: Ubilink.AI (Ubitus, Foxlink Group, Shinfox Energy JV)
notes: Foxlink Group (formerly Cheng Uei Precision) inaugurated Ubilink on Nov 14, 2024: Taiwan's largest AI supercomputing center, located in New Taipei City, powered by 1,024 NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with 45.82 PFLOPS peak, ranked 31st on the Nov 2024 TOP500 and 44th on Green500. Data Center Map lists it under New Taipei City. No MW capacity published.

name: CHT Taoyuan Fuguo IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the Taoyuan Fuguo IDC in Taoyuan City as an operational IDC site. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Zhongli Renmei IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the Zhongli Renmei IDC (Zhongli District, Taoyuan City) as an operational IDC site. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Lunping AI Data Center
notes: Chunghwa Telecom commenced operations at its new AI data center in Lunping, Taoyuan in 2025 (confirmed on the Q2 2025 earnings call), scalable to 36 MW at full build-out for AI/cloud demand. Baxtel lists 'Lunping Internet Data Center' with year built 2024.

name: Microsoft Azure Taiwan Region Data Centers (Taoyuan)
notes: Microsoft's official local blog states it selected the North Taiwan (Taoyuan) area as the regional launch zone for its Azure Taiwan region and has started construction of data center projects, with the first building estimated for completion in 2024. The region was first announced in Oct 2020 under the Reimagine Taiwan initiative; Azure still lists Taiwan as an announced/coming region, so status recorded as construction pending launch.

name: Google Tainan Data Center
notes: Taiwanese officials gave assent in Oct 2019 for Google's second hyperscale facility in Tainan, with a reported US$850m investment (DCD); Google also signed a 10 MW solar PPA in Tainan. As of March 2024 Google Taiwan GM said the Tainan plan was still under assessment pending market demand; no construction completion confirmed as of check, so status recorded as planned.

name: CHT Tainan Yongkang IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC page lists Tainan Yongkang IDC (Yongkang District, Tainan City) as operational; Data Center Map shows it as the only listed facility in Tainan with dedicated 1 Gbps connectivity. No capacity figure published.

name: CHT Tainan Zhongshan IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists the Tainan Zhongshan IDC as an operational IDC site in Tainan City. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Taipei Xinyi IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists Taipei Xinyi IDC as an operational IDC site in Taipei City. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Taipei Aiguo IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists Taipei Aiguo IDC as an operational IDC site in Taipei City. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Taipei East 7 IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists Taipei East 7 IDC; the same page also lists Taipei East 6 IDC and Taipei Jiantan IDC, giving CHT at least six IDC sites in Taipei City proper (Xinyi, Aiguo, East 6, East 7, Jiantan, plus the flagship Taipei/Banqiao campus). No capacity published.

name: Chief Telecom LY2 Datacenter (Neihu)
notes: Chief Telecom LY2 is located at No. 250 Yangguang Street, Neihu District, Taipei City; it became operational in June 2024 and is described as the only high-specification AI internet data center (IDC) in Taiwan until at least 2026 (Taiwan Business TOPICS). twreporter notes Chief Telecom is building two 20 MW facilities, one in Neihu (Taipei) and one at Central Taiwan Science Park; LY2 is the Neihu facility.

name: AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region
notes: AWS launched its Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region (ap-east-2) on June 6, 2025 with three Availability Zones, backed by a US$5 billion investment commitment in Taiwan; AWS announced the region as 'in the works' in 2024. Physical data center site locations are not publicly disclosed; the region is named for Taipei, so it is attributed to Taipei division with that caveat.

name: CHT Taichung Wenshin IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists Taichung Wenshin IDC as an operational IDC site; a third-party listing (OCOLO) describes a 10-floor building with two underground floors and about 200 racks. No MW capacity published.

name: CHT Taichung Liming IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official IDC location page lists Taichung Liming IDC as an operational IDC site in Taichung City. No published capacity figure found.

name: CHT Taichung AI Data Center (TWSE capacity)
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's Q2 2025 earnings call (as covered by transcript aggregators) reported a second AI data center under construction in Taichung with dedicated capacity for the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE). Capacity figure not published; evidence is secondary transcript coverage, so grade C.

name: Chief Telecom Central Taiwan Science Park AI Data Center
notes: Chief Telecom announced in March 2025 it will spend NT$3 billion (about US$96 million) to build its fourth AI data center at the Central Taiwan Science Park (Taichung), expected to begin operations in 2028 (Taiwan News/CNA); twreporter earlier reported a 20 MW Chief Telecom facility planned for the same park, and Chief Telecom confirmed the NT$3bn fourth AI data center plan.
